item.subject: science
item.stem:
Aditya examines three labelled slides: thin flat cheek cells, a long nerve cell with branches, and spindle-shaped muscle cells from the food pipe. He knows cheek cells form a protective lining, nerve cells carry messages, and muscle cells contract to help move food.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: The thin flat shape of cheek cells helps them form a protective lining; the long branched shape of the nerve cell helps it carry messages.
options.B: The nerve cell is long because carrying messages stretches it.
options.C: Cheek cells and the nerve cell in Aditya's body have the same shape and the same function.
options.D: The long nerve cell moves food down the food pipe because both the cell and the food pipe are long.
